title: Introduce spectral-behavior-checker CI hook for subtle response-style regressions
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Add a new CI hook and eval-harness integration — spectral-behavior-checker — that measures shifts in the spectral decomposition of response embeddings across a canonical prompt set to detect subtle style/response-distribution regressions. Motivation: Traditional scalar metrics (accuracy/ROUGE/bleu) miss gradual shifts in generation style or semantics that degrade downstream UX; this hook provides a compact signal (spectral drift score) sensitive to low-magnitude but broad changes in embedding space. Implementation: 1) New CI hook implemented in ci/hooks/spectral-checker.ts that runs as an optional pre-merge step and computes a singular-value-spectrum signature over an embedding matrix produced by the harness. 2) Introduce a baseline snapshot format under eval-harness/snapshots/spectral/ with compressed signatures and metadata (model, seed, prompt-set-id). 3) Add an eval-harness plugin (eval-harness/plugins/spectral_plugin.py) that exports a CLI to generate baselines, compute live comparison scores, and produce an artifact JSON summarizing the top-k modes that shifted. 4) CI integration: the hook can be configured to soft-fail (annotate and warn) or hard-fail (block) based on a per-prompt-set adaptive threshold; default for new repos is soft-fail. 5) Lightweight approximations included (randomized SVD sampler) to keep runtime under existing CI budgets. Testing: synthetic-shift unit tests added under tests/spectral/ that inject controlled perturbations at varying magnitudes and verify score monotonicity and false-positive rates; integration smoke test runs the CLI against a small internal prompt-set in the PR workflow; benchmarks included show median runtime of 28s on CI runners for a 500-prompt sample using 1536-d embeddings. Backwards compat: no change to existing gates unless teams opt in via repo config. Docs: add usage and calibration guide to docs/eval/spectral-checker.md. Rollout plan: default soft-fail for 2 weeks, auto-escalate to hard-fail after cross-team calibration and Linear signoff. Related: ENG-4627 (evaluation signal taxonomy) and ENG-4891 (CI gating enhancements).
commits: 4 commits: initial spectral plugin and SVD sampler; CLI + baseline snapshot writer; CI hook wiring and GH action; tests and docs; each commit small and focused; high-level commit messages retained in history.
review_thread: Liam O'Connor: Nice idea; can we bound the additional CI time? Add a randomized-sample path for large corpora.
Maya Chen: Added randomized SVD sampler and an opt-in sample-size config; included runtime numbers in the PR description and benchmarks file.
Priya Raman: How sensitive is the spectral score to embedding model changes? Could produce false positives when we upgrade embedding model.

Maya Chen: Snapshot metadata includes embedding model name and hash; the CLI will automatically skip comparisons when the embedding model changes unless the project config allows cross-model baselines. Added explicit note in the docs.
Evan Park: Approve after one nit: make the default threshold calibration conservative and document calibration steps.
Maya Chen: Adjusted default threshold to a conservative value and added calibration checklist in docs.
CI Bot: workflow/eval-hooks.yml passed on rerun (unit, lint, smoke).
release_notes: Introduce spectral-behavior-checker: a CI hook and eval-harness plugin for detecting subtle response-style regressions via spectral analysis of response embeddings. Opt-in soft-fail by default; CLI for baseline snapshot generation and calibration guide included.
notes_for_ops: To enable: add eval_hooks: [spectral-behavior-checker] to .eval-config.yml and create a baseline snapshot using `spectral-cli snapshot --name baseline-v1`. When switching embedding models, regenerate baselines. Monitor the artifact bucket for generated JSONs.
observability_impact: Emits a spectral-drift.score metric and a spectral-drift.top_modes list in artifact JSON for downstream dashboards; low cardinality and sample-rate by default to limit metrics cost.
security_considerations: No secrets introduced; snapshot artifacts are compressed JSON and should be stored in existing artifact buckets with current ACLs. CI step runs in the repo runner and requires no elevated privileges.
migration_instructions: Existing repos not affected until opt-in. For teams that want hard-fail, set mode: hard in .eval-config.yml and run calibration using docs checklist.
